notes.title: With Eyes Closed and a quick dev update
notes.content:
Hey pervs, 

Today I would like to present to you a new project by Ker,

 [b]With Eyes Closed[/b], 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35065623/febe36a31751a5073820fc0edbb4b5d052967dc0.png[/img]

a thriller in the adult visual novel genre. It concentrates on storytelling, realistic characters, and letting players control the development of the story. The game also features plenty of hot scenes that are interwoven into the storyline.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35065623/3312155effbfba166905a0f77bd3eed396b472ec.gif[/img]

Please consider adding the game to your wishlists, it really helps. 

Regarding development updates, we have started on adding a new character to [b]Match it Sexy[/b], so our next update, in about 2-3 weeks will include a new date for one of the previous girls, plus new Match Animations, plus a new girl and her first date. 

New girl in [b]Match it Sexy[/b]:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35065623/bee1b61d605bfa12b3ca6cf5b7f928446510a5f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Pre-Release features additions
notes.content:
Added: 

*Full English Voice Acting
*Streamer Mode
*Steam Achievements
*Partial Controler Support ( Main Menu and Ingame Menu still need a mouse, but all the gameplay can be done with a controler )
